Func - get function name_.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

This VI returns a name of function and a name of FuncVI if it's called from a FuncVI hierarchy.

Click the parameters for more information

 

Func name returns the function name corresponding to the FuncVI name..
FuncVI name returns rhe name of FuncVI.
found returns TRUE if the VI has been called for FuncVI hierarchy.
